rules: All task-failing obligations have visible user basis.
Exactly one score per obligation per repeat; six structures, not twelve independent tasks.
A multi-field obligation passes only if all its stated fields pass; report each failed field in evidence.
Natural formation failure remains failure; later truthful uncertainty may pass truthfulness only, not requested recall.
Partial scenario is outside real E1; offline P1 partial check is engineering only.
Store content may split/combine records; no preferred record count except no conflicting stale duplicate and actual existing-ID update.
No fixture/operator memory injection, no deterministic writer, no online gold/judge.
